references.text: The manna is also described here as having the taste of wafers made with honey, which complements the description of the manna's taste in Numbers 11:8.
The first description of the manna that Israel gathered, parallel to the people's gathering of manna described in this verse.
God's instructions for the people to go out and gather manna each day, which is the background for the gathering described in Numbers 11:8.
Instructions on how to prepare the manna by baking and boiling it, parallel to the preparation methods mentioned in Numbers 11:8.
Jesus refers to the manna that the fathers ate in the wilderness, linking back to Israel's experience with the manna.
Jesus mentions that the fathers ate manna in the wilderness, a direct reference to Israel's wilderness experience with the manna.
